thm:methods.statement: Expected conditional free-slot permutation TV tends to0 after40000(400+1)sweeps; full-deck TV tends to0 after16040400d physical shuffles.
thm:methods.conditions: n=2^d; independent fair coordinate switches; fixed half of labels with all their paths revealed; worst deterministic start outside the expectation.
thm:methods.constants: Conditional time is16040000 sweeps; extra400 sweeps couples outside labels. Average under actual path law,not every environment. No effective finite d0 or deployable epsilon threshold. Support bound TV>=1-2^(tn/2)/n!.

lem:slot-kernel.statement: A feasible outside labelled-path event fixes exactly its incident time-edge coins; remaining bits stay independent fair and induce a bijection of free slots.
lem:slot-kernel.conditions: Fixed observed labels and feasible full paths; canonical increasing endpoint slot maps; disjoint time intervals.
lem:slot-kernel.constants: Outgoing assignment is a composed with g inverse; later interval permutations act on the left. Full future-path conditioning still leaves unused earlier free coins independent; no assertion that g is already uniform.

lem:coarse-block-estimates.statement: Exact two-copy collision kernel yields contraction off coarse constants,balanced ending blocks and a small expected output coarse energy.
lem:coarse-block-estimates.conditions: Blocked set size<=n/2; h=floor(d/2),good means blocked fraction<=3/4 in every coarse block. The coarse-energy estimate additionally requires sum u=0.
lem:coarse-block-estimates.constants: A_E(x,y)=2^-j product_{k>j}(1+p_k(x))/2; q=7/8; epsilon_n=n[(3/2)/2^(3/4)]^(2^h). Output coarse energy<=(4*2^-h+epsilon_n)||u||².

prop:half-preparation.statement: Every specified ordered k<=n/2 label tuple is within n^-3 TV of a uniform ordered injection after400 sweeps.
prop:half-preparation.conditions: All sufficiently large d,uniform in deterministic initial layout; actual prefixes used in sequential TV telescoping.
prop:half-preparation.constants: Two-sweep energy bound n^-1/20 applied200times gives n^-10 squared energy; condition on paths first,then coarsen to endpoints. Not independent endpoint coordinates.

lem:character-fixed-points.statement: Fixed-point control gives normalized character bounds D^-delta or D^-delta r^(delta f).
lem:character-fixed-points.conditions: Fixed0<delta<1/4; all sufficiently large r depending only on delta; irreducible complex characters of S_r.
lem:character-fixed-points.constants: If f<=r^(1-4delta),|chi|/D<=D^-delta. General f uses branching with multiplicity and trivial cap; fixed-slack Larsen-Shalev input has unknown threshold.

lem:degree-sum.statement: Sum of D_lambda^-2 over degrees>1 tends to0 as symmetric-group size grows.
lem:degree-sum.conditions: Exclude trivial and sign one-dimensional representations; fixed exponent2.
lem:degree-sum.constants: Elementary hook/tableau argument; consequence sum D^-20=o1. Same old summability ingredient,not a new application gain.

thm:reset.statement: Full-deck TV tends to0 after171798691968d physical shuffles.
thm:reset.conditions: Dyadic decks,independent fair switches,large d,uniform deterministic start.
thm:reset.constants: rho=2^-20,s=335544320,l=128,128(4s+1)d. Actual Lean Main obtains this full-deck conclusion from earlier1600d mixing by monotonicity; not verification of each reset proof step.

lem:reset-mass-contraction.statement: Two sweeps contract expected zero-sum signed mass energy by N^(-rho/16).
lem:reset-mass-contraction.conditions: Fixed0<rho<=1; deterministic holes h>=rho N; signed masses supported on holes,arbitrary past when starting.
lem:reset-mass-contraction.constants: N=2^d sufficiently large depending on rho. Intermediate density event plus block-variance telescoping; not deterministic pathwise strict contraction.

prop:reset-partial-mixing.statement: Ordered b<=(1-rho)N tuple endpoint TV<=N^-8 after2s sweeps in either coordinate order.
prop:reset-partial-mixing.conditions: Fixed0<rho<=1,s=ceil320/rho; sufficiently large d depending only on rho.
prop:reset-partial-mixing.constants: Reverse-order statement is needed to bound columns of the forward kernel. Does not replace actual forward reset with a reverse run.

prop:reset-minorization.statement: Forward kernel K of2s sweeps satisfies K²(x,y)>=(1-2N^-8)/|Omega|.
prop:reset-minorization.conditions: Full ordered injection space; both forward rows and reverse-order rows close to uniform; doubly stochastic kernel.
prop:reset-minorization.constants: Row AND column TV controls are used in overlap. Reset takes4s forward sweeps. Exact acceptance marking needs transition probability access and is an analysis device,not a free executable sampler.

prop:reset-conditional.statement: The hole assignment approaches uniform in expected TV even after all reset coins and nonhole mixing-sweep paths are revealed.
prop:reset-conditional.conditions: rho=2^-20,k=rho N nonholes,h=N-k holes;l128 reset4s+active1blocks; actual specified environment.
prop:reset-conditional.constants: Conditionally independent copies plus separate good/acceptance marks;central relative increment;h!nu^*l(id)<=q^l+o1. No exact formal counterpart for this entire conditional-reset statement established by selected source reading.

thm:overlay.statement: Full-deck TV tends to0 after33030144d physical shuffles.
thm:overlay.conditions: Dyadic decks,original fair switch law preserved by predictable extra switches.
thm:overlay.constants: 3Kcalls,K8,k65536phases,each21d layers. Formal Main full-deck consequence follows from older1600d by monotonicity; source overlay route not fully audited formally.

lem:overlay-preparation.statement: Any specified n/8 tuple approaches a uniform ordered injection after20d layers.
lem:overlay-preparation.conditions: Large d; any deterministic base layout and cyclic starting phase; independent random shear proof frame.
lem:overlay-preparation.constants: Deferred column coefficients yield fresh direction uniform outside a hyperplane; energy ratio1/2+1/8 after first d layers. Directions are not independent uniform vectors without the window constraint.

prop:overlay-call.statement: One group of n/8 base indices receives an almost uniform permutation conditional on the full base,with expected error uniform over pre-call histories.
prop:overlay-call.conditions: 65536 phases of20d preparation plus1active sweep; extra edges selected from pre-layer base information; independent fresh extra bits.
prop:overlay-call.constants: Canonical multiplier independent of incoming overlay. Full-base conditional statement is averaged; actual correlated segments compared to independent ideal ones by preparation,not simply assumed independent.

lem:transverse-rounds.statement: Three uniform row-column-row rounds on fixed8 balanced transverse groups approach uniform permutation TV.
lem:transverse-rounds.conditions: |R_i intersect C_j|=n/64; n=2^d large; each group shuffled independently uniform.
lem:transverse-rounds.constants: Count law p_M(x)=(m!)^(2K)/(M! product x_ij!) with fixed margins,not uniform over integer tables. Common lattice-cell smoothing upgrades local Gaussian estimates to discrete TV; weak convergence alone is insufficient.

thm:two-halves.statement: Full-deck TV tends to0 after400 b d physical shuffles with L2^23 and fixed b from p.
thm:two-halves.constants: Uses two unread companion inputs:conditional-information Theorem4.1 and partial-fourier conditional-product transfer. Image versus inverse-image caps both required. Fixed L before d tends infinity. Formal full-deck conclusion follows from1600d monotonicity.

lem:color-product.statement: Given the complete two-color occupancy history,within-color permutations are conditionally independent after canonical endpoint transport.
lem:color-product.conditions: Every feasible occupancy history; original independent fair coins; observation contains no labels within colors.
lem:color-product.constants: Mixed-edge coins fixed,same-color arrays disjoint and independent. The color history is not asserted independent of internal permutations. Selected actual TwoColors/ColorProduct definitions and theorem read.
